quote: Success is a process, not an event. Most people quit too early because they expect dramatic results after only a few weeks of effort.
author: Mindset Upgraded

quote: The truth: it takes 6 – 14 months for closing deals. Somebody click on your shit / offer (view / like /share / comment) are MICRO INDICATORS that it’s working.
author: Mindset Upgraded

quote: Coming from a place of 'I NEED' is an energetic trap that only creates more need in your life. The 'I HAVE' mindset involves coming from a place of being whole and successful now.
author: Mindset Upgraded

quote: You cannot comb your hair by combing the mirror (I need); you must comb your own hair first (I HAVE) for the reflection to change. Similarly, focusing on "needing" things only creates a reflection of "not having," whereas acting as if you already have the success you seek prepares the way for it to manifest.
author: Mindset Upgraded

quote: If you want rains, we need preparing for it by digging the trenches. Build the foundation only before the clients arrive.
author: Manifest Clients, Revenue, and Momentum

quote: The best FB Ads is not written before screen, but while on walk, in the jungle, swimming. Step away from the hustle and grind mentality.
author: Manifest Clients, Revenue, and Momentum

quote: Advertising ALWAYS works, but individuals don’t. We need time and framework to find the winning ads.
author: Manifest Clients, Revenue, and Momentum

quote: Forest = the big offer, the big idea (focus here). Trees = landing page. Leaves = the small stuff like buttons and tiny details.
author: Manifest Clients, Revenue, and Momentum

quote: People buy outcomes, not tools. Never talk about tools, but get them from A (symptom) to B (outcome) with our solution.
author: Me Too to Desirable Offer

quote: I specialize in helping you get people who actually get you money. Specialization creates clarity.
author: Me Too to Desirable Offer

quote: The best follow-up messages remind people of what they wanted. Good follow-up feels like collaboration, not chasing.
author: Follow Up With Power

quote: The reason they don’t buy from you is because of trust. The more you show them how it works, the more real it is.
author: Follow Up With Power

quote: Most people are bombarded with generic follow-ups like 'Did you get my last email?'. The best follow-up gives a new helpful idea.
author: Follow Up With Power

quote: If they don’t buy into your plan, they won’t buy your sale. If they buy the plan, they’ll buy our sale.
author: Cold To Sold

quote: The 'DREAMER' loves the idea of the result, but they are a long ways away from pulling the trigger. The 'HOT BUYER' is actively shopping for a solution right now.
author: Cold To Sold

quote: Urgency services reward speed. Someone who shows up and quotes the fastest often gets the deal.
author: Cold To Sold

quote: You do not need to solve ALL the problems. You only need to solve ONE meaningful problem, and you can build a whole empire around that.
author: Mindset Upgraded

quote: Elegant simplicity beats feature overload. THE WEALTHY GETS PAID FOR RESULTS, not complexity.
author: Mindset Upgraded

quote: The more fun, the more sustainable business is. Never start from the un-fun money part.
author: Mindset Upgraded

quote: What you're saying is always about them and what they're trying to do. Always. 100%.
author: Organic Daily Pipeline

quote: We 'CHOOSE TO', not 'have to'. The language you use changes your energy.
author: Organic Daily Pipeline

quote: FEED A HUNGRY CROWD instead of convincing the wrong audience. Selling becomes easier when the market already wants the thing.
author: Organic Daily Pipeline

quote: The future will be noisier. The follow-up system is how you cut through the noise by repetition and staying in front of people.
author: Follow Up With Power

quote: Most people focus on the service/ tools instead of the outcome. Lead with the thing people actually want.
author: Follow Up With Power

quote: The best opportunities are often fumbled balls near the goal line. Sometimes the easiest growth comes from recovering what was already there.
author: Cold To Sold

quote: The right audience changes everything. If you take the same ribs to an Alabama football game, you barely have to say anything to make a sale.
author: Cold To Sold

quote: What most people don't realize—there are people in every industry with that level of influence.
author: Shoe Store Tools

quote: Spend 5 – 10 mins to find out: Who are they? What are they about? What are they trying to sell / promote to their audience? (most important)
author: Shoe Store Tools

quote: Avoid “I, we / the reason I message you” --> But “their own agenda (lợi ích riêng)”
author: Shoe Store Tools

quote: Always open with a “give”, not “take”. Exp: I have some ideas, tools, gifts for your audience …
author: Shoe Store Tools

quote: The biggest barrier of all things is TRUST. So the more you can do the sth cool for them on step 1, then you don’t have to try nearly as hard to have their trust on step 2.
author: Shoe Store Tools

quote: The specific bonus ideas for above Ben’s channel: A Question-and-Answer Library, Swipe Files of Ads, Preset Targeting Options, Canva Images of Winning Ads, Actionable Course Materials.
author: Shoe Store Tools

quote: It do 2 categories: Help you sell your things, make you more money for what you’re trying to do. I know you have these things on your plate this week, so I just did the things for you.
author: Shoe Store Tools

quote: They already have products, audience/ followers, tools, materials, relationships, resources… They already do the hard works building the audience. What we do is: taking the existing shits, and organizing it in a new and useable way.
author: Shoe Store Tools

quote: And would you be okay with trying this with one or two people? When you ask it that way, you are making it safe for them because they do not have to risk their entire reputation on you.
author: Shoe Store Tools

quote: Quality is better than quantity. 254 subscribers who concerns about CRM is more worthy than 10k views.
author: Shoe Store Tools

quote: Long term goal = Trust & Recommendation from Gate Keeper.
author: Shoe Store Tools

quote: BE PERSISTENT: Influencers often require 3-5 messages just to start a conversation. Chicken soup for the soul needed 5 years to appear on Oprah
author: Shoe Store Tools

quote: Strategic entrepreneur is always crush tactical bros (exp: send 1K DM/ day).
author: Shoe Store Tools

quote: Strategic thinking: Artist makes more sale in 3 days than the rest of the year. There're approximately 500 artists come together to set up booths in a single park, the festival attracts 60,000 visitors
author: Shoe Store Tools

quote: Truth: It’s easier to help people in the big leagues than smaller ones. Since they’re already have team, social media, tickets, everything set up, know how to sell it, know how to re-target it.
author: Shoe Store Tools

quote: Sell the results, not activities. We sell a cleaned backyard, not a lawn mower / techniques / time for 20 mins…
author: Shoe Store Tools

quote: Sell their products on FB Market Place with our copies. The feedback (win/fail) will tell you whether the offer works or not. Also we can use this offer as a “first date” for shoe stores.
author: Shoe Store Tools

quote: Be specific with a niche, or our messages will too broad and nobody cares. Btw one qualified client is better than 17 un-qualified ones.
author: Shoe Store Tools

quote: The Custom GPT's logic: The Input; The Output ; The Steps in Between ; Preference
author: Shoe Store Tools

quote: Stop trying to create hungers. Go find where hungers already exists, then put your offer in front of it.
author: Shoe Store Tools

quote: Find the people who are: already buying, already searching, already attending events, already reading books, already in communities, already paying coaches, already using software, already trying to solve the problem.
author: Shoe Store Tools

quote: Then your job is to create a reason for that person to : introduce you, interview you, promote you, partner with you, or let you help their audience.
author: Shoe Store Tools

quote: Say you sell marketing services to dentists. You could ask: Who already has access to a bunch of dentists?
author: Shoe Store Tools

quote: A restaurant outside bars at 2–3 a.m. doesn’t need world-class food. It wins because drunk, hungry people walk out starving and there are few options open.
author: Shoe Store Tools

quote: Selling chocolate bars door-to-door took hours. Selling the same chocolate bars outside a grocery store took 15 minutes, because the grocery store already had buyer flow: people came there hungry, ready to spend money on food.
author: Shoe Store Tools
